case_title: ROBERT BERGER ET AL VS. AMIR IZADPANAH

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,485.00 FILED BY BERGER, ROBERT BERGER, JULIE AS TO DEFENDANT IZADPANAH, AMIR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-24-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$0.00) SERVED JUN-10-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT IZADPANAH, AMIR

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-24-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-31-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ROBERT BERGER IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF JULIE BERGER IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT AMIR IZADPANAH IS PRESENT. STEPHANIE RENE LYTAR TESTIFIES ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT STATES TO THE COURT THAT PLAINTIFF IS AN ATTORNEY. PLAINTIFF CONFIRMS TO THE COURT THAT HE IS AN ATTORNEY, NOT LICENSED IN CALIFORNIA BUT IS A LICENSED ATTORNEY IN WASHINGTON. PLAINTIFF ALSO STATES THAT HE HAS NOT PRACTICED FOR 15 YEARS. COURT RECOGNIZES PLAINTIFF'S STATUS AS AN ATTORNEY, BUT THAT HE IS NOT LICENSED OR PRACTING IN CALIFORNIA. COURT STATES THAT IF THIS KNOWLEDGE WAS PRESENTED BEFORE TESTIMONY BEGAN, THIS MATTER WOULD HAVE BEEN CONTINUED TO ALLOW CO-PLAINTIFF JULIE BERGER, WHO IS NOT AN ATTORNEY, TO BE PRESENT AND PROVIDE TESTIMONY, SINCE SMALL CLAIMS RULES PROHIBITS REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. COURT ALLOWS THIS MATTER TO GO FORWARD. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT. DEFENDANT AGREES TO PAY PLAINTIFF $435.50 AS A FULL SETTLEMENT VIA PAYPAL. A PROGRESS REPORT DATE IS SET. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRE IF PAYMENT IS MADE AS AGREED AND THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. IF PAYMENT IS NOT MADE APPEARANCES ARE REQUIRED AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER CONTINUE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. MATTER CONTINUED TO AUG-31-2021 AT 10:00 A.M. IF NO APPEARANCE, CASE IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT OF AUG-25-2021.
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT OF AUG-25-21. NO APPEARANCES. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
